abstract: A novel label-free framework for visual reasoning called V-Zero is presented, which uses contrastive evidence gating to improve fine-grained visual reasoning without requiring annotated answer labels, achieving faster training than traditional methods.

title: UnityShots: Memory-Driven Multi-Shot Audio-Video Generation with Boundary-Aware Gating
abstract: UnityShots is a memory-driven audio-video generation system that maintains consistent subject appearance and audio across video cuts using fixed-size long-term and short-term memory slots with boundary-conditioned gates and discrete cut-type priors.

title: Causal-rCM: A Unified Teacher-Forcing and Self-Forcing Open Recipe for Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation in Streaming Video Generation and Interactive World Models
abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion extends diffusion distillation frameworks to real-time streaming generation through causal training paradigms, achieving state-of-the-art performance with fast convergence and interactive world modeling capabilities.

title: IV-CoT: Implicit Visual Chain-of-Thought for Structure-Aware Text-to-Image Generation
abstract: Implicit Visual Chain-of-Thought decomposes visual conditioning into structural and semantic cascades for improved structure-aware image generation with sketch supervision.

title: EBench: Elemental Diagnosis of Generalist Mobile Manipulation Policies
abstract: EBench is a comprehensive simulation benchmark for evaluating generalist mobile manipulation policies across diverse tasks and dimensions, revealing distinct capability profiles and generalization patterns among state-of-the-art models.

title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Agentic AI: From Foundations to Systems
abstract: The book provides a comprehensive guide to building autonomous AI systems, covering foundational elements like transformer architecture and training methods, along with advanced topics such as reinforcement learning, agent architectures, and production deployment.

title: Look Light, Think Heavy: What Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Can and Cannot Do
abstract: Multimodal Chain-of-Thought reasoning shows selective effectiveness across different tasks, with limitations in maintaining visual introspection during reasoning processes.

title: Advancing WordArt-Oriented Scene Text Recognition: Datasets and Methods
abstract: A large-scale synthetic dataset and specialized model architecture are introduced to address the challenges of artistic text recognition by improving data diversity and model flexibility for irregular text layouts.

title: ReNIO: Reweighting Negative Trajectory Importance for LLM On-Policy Distillation
abstract: ReNIO enhances on-policy distillation for language models by reweighting negative trajectories based on token-level probability ratios, improving reasoning performance in mathematical and code generation tasks.

title: RL-Index: Reinforcement Learning for Retrieval Index Reasoning
abstract: RL-Index introduces an agentic indexing framework that shifts reasoning from query time to indexing stage by using LLM-generated rationales and reinforcement learning to improve retrieval effectiveness and reduce latency.

title: CAVEWOMAN: How Large Language Models Behave Under Linguistic Input and Output Compression
abstract: Two-channel evaluation shows output compression reduces costs while input compression increases costs and degrades accuracy across models and datasets.

title: RoPE-Aware Bit Allocation for KV-Cache Quantization
abstract: Block-GTQ introduces a RoPE-aware bit allocation method for key-cache quantization that improves attention accuracy and downstream performance through adaptive bit distribution and packed cache serving.

title: When Lower Privileges Suffice: Investigating Over-Privileged Tool Selection in LLM Agents
abstract: LLM agents frequently select higher-privilege tools unnecessarily, and while safety alignment doesn't ensure least-privilege choices, a post-training defense can reduce excessive privilege use without sacrificing performance.

title: What Intermediate Layers Know: Detecting Jailbreaks from Entropy Dynamics
abstract: Jailbreak attacks expose vulnerabilities in aligned large language models, revealing that harmful intent is encoded in structured intermediate uncertainty dynamics rather than output representations.

title: PrivacyAlign: Contextual Privacy Alignment for LLM Agents
abstract: Researchers develop a human-centered approach to align AI agents with privacy norms by creating a comprehensive dataset of privacy judgments and using annotation-conditioned reward modeling to improve agent behavior.

title: Lite Any Stereo V2: Faster and Stronger Efficient Zero-Shot Stereo Matching
abstract: Lite Any Stereo V2 (LAS2) presents an efficient stereo matching approach that achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with significantly reduced latency through optimized architecture and training strategies.

title: Do Thinking Tokens Help with Safety?
abstract: Research reveals that reasoning models' safety outcomes are predictable from early hidden representations, with deliberation appearing but not substantially influencing final responses, and current safety interventions inadvertently suppress genuine deliberation signals.

title: Plans Don't Persist: Why Context Management Is Load Bearing for LLM Agents
abstract: Standard LLM agents rely on plan content remaining in context rather than maintaining it as persistent state, with evidence shown through replay pairing diagnostics and compression stress tests.

title: Distill Once, Adapt Life-Long: Exploring Dataset Distillation for Continual Test-Time Adaptation
abstract: DO-ALL is a test-time adaptation framework that uses dataset distillation to create synthetic anchors for stable long-term model performance without retaining source data.

title: Constraint Tax in Open-Weight LLMs: An Empirical Study of Tool Calling Suppression Under Structured Output Constraints
abstract: Tool Suppression occurs when JSON Schema constraints and tool calling are jointly enabled, preventing open-weight models from invoking tools despite maintaining schema compliance, with the issue stemming from grammar-based token masking that makes tool-call tokens unreachable during decoding.

title: Speaker Identity in Non-Verbal Vocalizations: Conditional Distillation and Mixture of Experts Approach
abstract: A novel speaker verification framework combines frozen self-supervised features with ECAPA-TDNN and MoE modules to improve identity verification across both speech and non-verbal vocalizations while maintaining speech performance.

title: Forecasting Future Behavior as a Learning Task
abstract: Behavior Forecasters are trained to predict large reasoning model outputs from single trajectories, outperforming large language models while requiring significantly less computational cost.

title: Anthropic’s Claude is winning over paid consumers, a market owned by ChatGPT
abstract: Consumers who pay for AI have been increasingly choosing Anthropic’s Claude, trend data from credit card transaction analysis company Indagari shows. Indagari analyzes billions of anonymized credit card transactions from about 28 million U.S. consumers. Interest in Claude among consumers on DataCamp has exploded since the start of the year. “Claude” is now the most searched term on its site, even more than the term “AI,” DataCamp tells TechCrunch. While ChatGPT courses are still far more popular with businesses doing corporate training, among self-directed consumers, demand for Claude courses is outpacing ChatGPT by three to one, the company says. title: General Intuition’s $2.3B bet that video games can train AI agents for the real world
abstract: As soon as I entered General Intuition’s R&D floor at its New York office, the company’s 31-year-old co-founder and CEO Pim de Witte directed my attention to a monitor perched on a standing desk. Someone appeared to be playing something like Fortnite. It wasn’t a person. “Our agent has been playing for 100 hours straight,” Kent Rollins, the company’s chief product officer, said, beaming. Before I could get absorbed in the spectacle of an AI navigating the game’s virtual environment, I heard the electronic footsteps of a large quadrupedal robot approaching. “The same brain powering the agent playing the game is powering the robot,” de Witte told me. Josh Duplantis, a data analyst carrying a laptop streaming a live feed from the robot’s single camera, piped up to explain that the bot’s default mode was “exploration.” Relying on that camera, its singular eye, the giant buglike bot walked up to me, circled around me, and continued into the office. It occasionally clipped the legs of chairs or bumped into an errant trash bin, much like a toddler who hasn’t yet learned how her body relates to the world around it. Duplantis said it took just eight minutes of real-world robotics data to fine-tune an AI model for the quadruped. What’s more, that data was collected on the street, not inside the office where the bot was currently navigating itself. An agentic model that can generalize from gameplay to simulation to embodiment is General Intuition’s raison d’être. And that model’s ability to figure out its place in the world has secured the backing of some heavy hitters. On Thursday, General Intuition said it raised $320 million at a $2.3 billion valuation, confirming TechCrunch’s previous reporting . The round brings General Intuition’s total disclosed funding to $454 million, after the $134 million round it raised at launch last October. title: Databricks’ former AI chief thinks he can cut AI’s power bill by 1,000x
abstract: The drive to discover the next big thing in AI has funded some pretty ambitious projects — but one company is taking it as a chance to rebuild computing architecture from the ground up. Led by Naveen Rao, formerly the head of AI at Databricks, Unconventional AI promises to make inference processing vastly more power efficient. The secret weapon: a new kind of oscillator-based computer architecture. On Thursday, the company released its first model AI — called Un-0 — an image-generation system tool that shows for the first time how the company’s technology can replicate conventional AI systems. In an accompanying new paper, the company’s research team details how they built a fully functional image-generation model using a software simulation of the new architecture — one that performs just as well as state-of-the-art diffusion models. “This is the ‘hello world’ of a new kind of computer,” Rao told TechCrunch. “Over the next year, you’re going to start seeing some pretty interesting news around this.” The output from the new Un-0 model is similar to that of image-generation models like Stable Diffusion or OpenAI’s GPT Image 1. The impressive part is how it arrives at that performance. The model is built on an oscillator-based architecture that is completely different from the chips that power conventional computing and traditional LLMs. The advantages of the oscillator-based computing are complex, but Rao believes it will ultimately reduce power use by as much as 1,000 times. Much of the infrastructure to get there is still being built. The current version of Un-0 runs on a software simulation of Unconventional’s oscillator chips, but the company plans to release schematics for an actual chip soon. title: Netris raises $15M Series A from a16z to help AI neoclouds go live faster
abstract: The AI boom has encouraged everyone and their uncle to launch a data center business. But spinning up a data center isn’t easy. Even if you solve the problem of securing the GPUs, network switches, and storage, you still have to get everything configured, running, and be able to cater to customers’ various needs. Getting a data center ready to provide cloud-computing services specifically for AI inference and training services can take months of work. And the longer you take to get to market, the higher the cost of having all those precious GPUs sitting idle. Network automation startup Netris claims it can make that problem disappear for neoclouds. The company provides software that runs on network switches, and it also offers a platform that connects to switches to help neocloud operators reduce the time it takes to go live by automating setup, configuration, and operations. The platform also provides network abstraction, so hardware configurations can be changed as required, and it isolates servers and resources at the hardware layer so neoclouds can serve multiple customers (multi-tenancy). If that sounds like a solution to an obvious problem, you’re not wrong. Until recently, data centers were largely the domain of large infrastructure operators like Equinix, NTT, Digital Realty, Oracle, Microsoft, AWS, or Google. Those companies pretty much solved network setup, configuration, and multi-tenancy for themselves by hiring ranks of engineers or building the automation themselves. Small neocloud businesses rarely have such resources at their disposal. “As a GPU cluster operator, you need to make configuration changes to every link, every day. At traditional data centers, they were using something called SDN [software-defined networking] to do this, but SDN is falling short, because it’s a software technology,” Netris’ CEO Alex Saroyan told TechCrunch. “For AI, software is not okay, because the amount of traffic is so high, everything must be hardware accelerated. title: Adobe acquires image and video enhancement tool maker Topaz Labs
abstract: Adobe on Thursday said it is acquiring Topaz Labs , which offers AI models for video and image enhancement, and that it will make it a part of its creative business. Topaz Labs, which won an Emmy last year for its production tech , has existed for more than two decades, making tools for enhancing videos and images. In recent years, the company has released its own models: Astra for AI video upscaling and Wonder for image retouching and enhancement. The startup has also worked on a technology that makes it easier to run large video models on consumer-grade GPUs. Adobe, which already offers some of Topaz’s tools in its Creative Cloud suite, said it will integrate Topaz’s models into its Firefly AI app as well as other parts of its image and video editing suites. Adobe said Topaz’s offerings will be available as stand-alone services through its website. Deepa Subramaniam, VP of product marketing for Creative Cloud at Adobe, said professionals who want to combine real-life footage with AI clips can use Topaz’s products for tasks like sharpening details, reducing noise, or restoring archival footage. “Topaz Labs brings deep expertise in optimizing large, complex AI models to run directly on device, a capability that will allow Adobe to deliver faster, more responsive experiences for customers and make advanced AI more accessible and cost-effective for creatives. In addition, Topaz Labs is trusted by professionals of all creative crafts – from designers and video professionals to photographers and enterprise creative teams,” Subramaniam said in an emailed statement. Adobe has been in fierce competition with Canva and DaVinci Resolve-owner Blackmagic Design in the image and video editing space. Adobe has been stuffing AI into all of its apps and has also created an AI-centric media editing studio with Firefly . title: Amazon ups India bet with fresh $13B AI infrastructure investment
abstract: Amazon on Thursday said it would invest an additional $13 billion to expand its AI and cloud footprint in India through 2030. The fresh investment, announced after Amazon CEO Andy Jassy met India’s Prime Minister Narendra Modi in New Delhi, will fund the expansion of Amazon Web Services’ data center capacity in Mumbai and Hyderabad. The announcement marks Amazon’s third major commitment for India in as many years. In 2023, following a meeting between Jassy and Modi, the company said it would invest $15 billion by 2030, including $12.7 billion for Amazon Web Services. It followed that with an over $35 billion commitment in December 2025. The company’s investment commitments in the country now total $48 billion. Amazon did not detail how the total $48 billion would be deployed across its India businesses. Long-term commitments by technology companies usually include both capital and operating expenditures, rather than only new infrastructure spending. Amazon’s announcement follows a wave of investments by global technology companies that are betting that India will become a major hub for the computing infrastructure needed to power artificial intelligence products. Microsoft said in December it would invest $17.5 billion in India by 2029, and Google said in October it would spend $15 billion to build an AI hub and data center infrastructure in the country. India has also attracted billions of dollars in commitments for data center projects from investors including Australia’s AirTrunk , Canada Pension Plan Investment Board’s CPP Investments , and domestic conglomerates Reliance Industries and Adani Group . New Delhi has sought to attract more investment through policy incentives, including tax exemptions for foreign cloud providers on services sold overseas if those workloads are run from Indian data centers. title: Europe is pushing back on Washington’s chip war
abstract: In Brief Posted: 5:08 PM PDT · June 24, 2026 Image Credits: Lina Selg/Bloomberg (opens in a new window) / Getty Images Connie Loizos Europe is pushing back on Washington’s chip war Dutch Trade Minister Sjoerd Sjoerdsma visited Washington this week to meet with Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and members of Congress to oppose the MATCH Act , a bill that would bar Chinese chipmakers from accessing Western semiconductor equipment, and one that would hit ASML especially hard. ASML, based in the Netherlands, is Europe’s most valuable company and the only maker in the world of the sophisticated lithography machines that are used to make cutting-edge AI chips. “It’s exceptional that I’m coming here to broadly outline our concerns to Congress,” Sjoerdsma told Bloomberg after the meetings. “The stakes for the Netherlands may be very high.” China accounts for 19% of ASML’s net system sales. The MATCH Act would go further than existing controls, extending curbs to ASML’s deep ultraviolet immersion machines on top of the long-standing ban on its most advanced extreme ultraviolet, or EUV, tools reaching China. As ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet told TechCrunch in May, what China can currently buy are older-generation deep ultraviolet tools — gear first shipped about a decade ago — the same machines the MATCH Act would now relegate as off-limits. The bill, introduced in April, hasn’t yet faced a full House or Senate vote; Bloomberg notes it would likely need to be folded into a larger package to pass. title: Former Infosys chief has a new startup that wants to challenge the IT services world
abstract: For decades, IT services firms made billions of dollars by allowing companies to outsource tech tasks like customizing, integrating, and maintaining enterprise software. Vishal Sikka, former CEO of Infosys, one of the largest such firms in India, is now betting that AI can do much of that work instead. His new startup, Hang Ten Systems , has raised a $32 million seed round led by Mayfield, it said Wednesday , with a strategic investment from Aramco Ventures and participation from angel investors. Hang Ten enters a market where IT services firms, including Infosys, are racing to adapt to AI through partnerships with companies like Anthropic and OpenAI . The startup’s launch comes amid a growing debate over whether AI will expand the industry’s addressable market or fundamentally alter how enterprise software is built, maintained, and delivered. Clearly, some enterprises are eager to try the AI-services idea, especially from someone as experienced as Sikka, who spent 12 years building enterprise software at SAP, and later as a board member for Oracle. Mayfield managing partner Navin Chaddha told TechCrunch that the company “just got started a month back” and already has customers. The startup said it is working with customers, including Siemens Gamesa Renewable Energy and Fresenius on AI-native project delivery. title: AI was supposed to kill engineering jobs, but new data suggests they’re the most resilient
abstract: Whether AI is already replacing jobs is the subject of fierce debate. Tech layoffs hit their highest single month total in years in May, and AI was the most-cited reason, according to outplacement firm Challenger, Gray & Christmas. Software engineering, in theory, is the professional field most vulnerable to automation, given the rapid adoption of AI-powered coding tools. However, researchers at venture firm SignalFire say the hiring data tells a different story. “The rationale given for lots of layoffs is consistently AI, and specifically they’ll say AI with respect to code; they’ll say one engineer could do the job of however many engineers in the past,” said Asher Bantock, SignalFire’s head of research. “What we’re seeing on the ground is a little inconsistent with that.” SignalFire’s analysis, which tracked the careers of millions of employees across more than 80 million companies, suggests that engineering was the most resilient job function in 2025. Instead of focusing on layoffs, which are difficult to track because people often delay updating their employment status after job cuts, SignalFire examined hiring data as a more accurate indicator of real-time workforce trends. While total hiring across large tech companies dropped 25% compared to 2019 levels, engineering roles saw a much smaller decline of just 11%, according to SignalFire’s latest “ State of Talent Report .” In fact, engineers comprised 55% of all new hires in 2025 across the 12 companies SignalFire classifies as “Tech Majors” — Alphabet, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Microsoft, Netflix, Nvidia, Tesla, Uber, Airbnb, Block, and Stripe. This is a significant jump from 2019, when engineers represented only 46% of new recruits, according to the report. The continued need for engineers was even more evident at early-stage startups, which collectively brought on 7% more engineers in 2025 than they did in 2019, SignalFire’s data shows. title: AI researchers continue to leave Google for its rivals
abstract: In Brief Posted: 2:42 PM PDT · June 24, 2026 Image Credits: TechCrunch Amanda Silberling Lucas Ropek AI researchers continue to leave Google for its rivals Top AI researchers Jonas Adler and Alexander Pritzel are leaving Google for Anthropic, according to Bloomberg . Per the report, Adler and Pritzel played key roles in the development of Google’s Gemini model. TechCrunch reached out to Google for comment. These departures are part of a concerning trend for Google. Last week, legendary AI researcher Noam Shazeer announced that he was leaving Google for OpenAI. Shazeer had been at Google since 2000, save for the three years he spent building his controversial chatbot startup, Character.AI (which Google effectively acqui-hired for $2.7 billion, in part to bring Shazeer back to work on Gemini). Just days after Shazeer made his announcement, Google DeepMind director John Jumper said he was leaving Google for Anthropic. Alongside DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis, Jumper won the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for his work on AlphaFold, which can predict 3D protein structures from animo acid sequences. As OpenAI and Anthropic prepare to go public , this trend could continue — it’s a great time for the companies to recruit top AI talent with a promise of equity. title: The memory chip crunch is paying off for this US company
abstract: In Brief Posted: 2:30 PM PDT · June 24, 2026 Image Credits: Jeremy Erickson/Bloomberg / Getty Images Kirsten Korosec The memory chip crunch is paying off for this US company The AI boom has fueled dozens of new startups and minted a new class of billionaires. It has also produced a serious shortage of memory chips — a critical component for compute-hungry AI models — which some predict could persist through 2027 . This era of RAMageddon isn’t just a corporate problem. As demand spikes and squeezes supply, prices are rising and trickling down to consumers. Apple CEO Tim Cook warned just a week ago that price increases for its products are unavoidable. But amid this Mad Max-esque fight for memory chips, some companies are coming out ahead. Micron, the largest U.S. computer-memory chip maker — with a market cap of $1.2 trillion — is one of them. That hasn’t always been the case. The company’s shares were trading around $83 in early 2024 (with a market cap of about $91 billion) and closed today at $1,048.51. The company reported third-quarter earnings after markets closed Wednesday, and the results sent shares soaring more than 13%. Revenue quadrupled to $41.45 billion compared with the same period a year ago. The company’s profit, meanwhile, rose from $1.88 billion to an incredible $28.2 billion year-over-year. The Idaho-based company also gave investors a positive outlook, forecasting fourth-quarter revenue of between $49 billion and $51 billion. The strong results arrive the same week Micron inked a deal to supply AI lab Anthropic with memory and storage chips. Micron also disclosed that it participated in Anthropic’s Series H funding round, though it didn’t disclose how much it invested. title: Companies are scrambling to stop employees from maxing out AI budgets with small tasks
abstract: In Brief Posted: 1:09 PM PDT · June 24, 2026 Image Credits: Kenneth Cheung (opens in a new window) / Getty Images Lucas Ropek Companies are scrambling to stop employees from maxing out AI budgets with small tasks The era of tokenmaxxing is over. After the AI industry encouraged companies to max out their AI budgets earlier this year, and some companies even built employee leaderboards to encourage internal AI usage — they are now realizing just how easy it is to spend huge sums of money on AI and get little in return. Enterprise Article Published June 25, 2026 Upvote - Kyle Wiggers Ai2Comms Follow allenai 📄 Tech report: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20936 Which kinds of tokens does a model predict well, and which does it not? That question is especially intriguing in the case of hybrids, a language model architecture that’s begun to challenge the standard transformer and that we’ve been investigating with Olmo Hybrid . Hybrids can match or beat transformers on standard benchmarks, but the headline numbers don’t reveal much about what specific advantages hybrid models have over transformers. In an attempt to shed light on these token-level behaviors, we recently conducted experiments comparing our own strongest 7B transformer, Olmo 3 , and hybrid model, Olmo Hybrid, head-to-head. Specifically, we compare the differences in model predictions in a fine-grained way across different types of tokens, or units of information that appear as input to an LLM. Because Olmo 3 and Olmo Hybrid were built to be as alike as possible outside their architectures — closely matched in data, tokenizer, and training recipe — any difference in their predictions mostly reflects the architecture itself. Viewing these differences at the token level allows us to glean insights about the specific strengths of hybrid models over transformers. Our results show that the hybrid’s advantage is real across many tokens, but not all. Olmo Hybrid is strongest on tokens that carry meaning, such as nouns, verbs, and adjectives, and on tokens that can only be predicted by following what’s going on, like which person a pronoun refers to. But the hybrid’s advantage almost disappears on tokens that simply repeat something already in the input — a word or phrase reproduced verbatim from earlier — where the answer is sitting right there to be looked up. abstract: The opinions expressed in this post are the authors’ views and not those of Cisco. Enterprise architectures have long been centered on REST APIs and microservices. These systems are stable, well-tested, and deeply embedded in production environments. They weren’t designed for Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, the emerging standard for autonomous agents that collaborate, reason, and coordinate through structured messaging. That worked in the absence of a common agent protocol, but it means many existing agents now sit outside the emerging A2A framework. The challenge today is no longer only adding A2A to traditional services. You also need to bring these REST-based agents into a standardized agent-to-agent world. In this technical collaboration between AWS and the authors, we present a pragmatic solution: agentic overlays . Agentic overlays are thin wrapper layers that transform traditional REST-based services into agents capable of participating in A2A interactions. They also expose REST APIs as tools compatible with the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Together, they let enterprises add A2A capabilities to existing REST services without rewriting business logic, without duplicating code, and without running parallel infrastructures. This reduces agent sprawl in the infrastructure by reusing existing services as agents. We provide reference architectures and sample code that show how to build agentic overlays. REST APIs are designed for deterministic, client-server integration. A client calls a well-defined endpoint, passes parameters, and receives a predictable response, typically in a stateless request-response flow governed by HTTP semantics. This makes REST excellent for exposing business capabilities (such as create, read, update, and delete) with clear contracts, strong compatibility, and operational simplicity. abstract: WAIC UP!｜AI圈都在聊引數，我們偏不 量子位的朋友們 2026-06-25 17:59:40 來源： 量子位 7月17-7月20 AI行業正在經歷一場集體眩暈。 昨天是引數屠榜，今天是融資數億，明天是某某模型橫空出世。資訊過載到麻木，內容高度趨同，行業評判標準被窄化為效率、引數與商業收益。能夠兼具人文底色的獨立思考，正在成為這個時代最稀缺的物種。 當機器能在幾秒鐘內解決任何問題時，人類的“低效”會變成大家都想要的奢侈體驗。——Andrew Bott｜WAIC UP! 第五期嘉賓、美國亞瓦派學院商學教授. 在這樣的語境下，WAIC UP!選擇了一條反直覺的路：不追著熱點跑，而是主動踩剎車。 過去一年，它以一本刊物為起點，逐步長成一個跨界思想共同體；2026年，它正從“思想陣地”進化為“人類最後的思辨防線”，為狂奔的AI產業，提供一份稀缺的清醒。 01｜六期刊物，六十種“不討好”的聲音 截至2026年3月，《WAIC UP!》已刊行 6 期季度思想刊物，匯聚 60 餘位全球跨界先行者——圖靈獎得主、院士學者、科幻作家、藝術家、天文學家——累計形成 50 萬字獨家深度內容，全網曝光突破 600 萬。 這 60 多位作者有一個共同特徵：他們不討好任何人。不告訴你“今天又有什麼新技術”，而是追問“這個技術對我們意味著什麼”。 翻看過去一年的代表性觀點，每一句都像一把刀，刺破行業表層繁榮： “思維鏈到底是不是一個對大模型思維內在機制嚴謹的表達？這可能是存疑的。”——張拳石｜上海交通大學電院電腦科學與工程系長聘副教授 “機器產生自主意願是個小機率事件，但人類放棄自主意願卻是個大機率事件。”——倪考夢｜溫州市委黨校副校長、AIGC公益專案組織者 “人形機器人為什麼要做成人形？為了實現這個人形，尤其在走穩這件事情上就花了很大的資源，如果換成兩個輪子又有什麼問題？”——顧磊磊｜上海交通大學長聘教軌副教授、博士生導師 “我們追求的是互補性，即打造本質上不同於現有智慧的新型人工智慧，而非僅僅實現已有智慧的自動化，然後讓它將我們的工作壓縮甚至取代我們。”——James Evans｜芝加哥大學社會學與資料科學Max Palevksy講席教授 “大模型規模擴張已觸頂，如果沒有新突破，很可靠能會引發嚴重的經濟問題。”——Stuart Russell｜美國國家工程院院士，加州大學伯克利分校電腦科學傑出教授 “一個好的教育系統，應該像一片熱帶雨林，允許不同的‘物種’以不同的方式生長、繁榮。AI可以幫助我們發現和滋養這種多樣性，而不是用統一的標準抹平它。”——倪閩景｜中國自然科學博物館學會副會長，上海科技館館長 這些聲音不迎合主流、不固化標準答案，它們提供的是技術圈內部最容易忽略的視角。 WAIC UP!的定位很清晰：不做AI世界的“前線戰報”，做“後方教研室”。 前者告訴行業“仗打得怎麼樣”，後者幫從業者理解“這仗該不該打、打贏了之後我們去哪”。兩者缺一不可。 02｜從上海到香港，兩場線下活動，讓思辨從紙上走到人群 思想不能只停留在PDF裡。 過去一年，WAIC UP!完成了兩次重要的線下落地，讓“思辨”成為可感知、可對話、可生長的現場體驗。 2025世界人工智慧大會WAIC UP!之夜·上海 ：2025年7月，WAIC UP!在上海世博展覽館辦了一場“叛逆”的夜間思辨活動，主題直接砸向行業狂熱：“AI，有什麼大不了？”那一晚最大的反饋不是“乾貨很多”，而是“原來有這麼多人和我一樣在困惑”——並且願意把困惑攤開來聊。原來在技術狂奔的時代，有這麼多人選擇停下來追問：人，到底憑什麼立於AI之上？ WAIC UP! 2026全球年終盛會·香港 ：2026年1月，WAIC首次南下，在香港科學園舉辦全球年終盛會，千餘名從業者到場。香港特區行政長官李家超影片致辭，40餘位全球頂尖學者與產業領袖登臺。這是WAIC五大生態品牌首次並聯亮相，標誌著內地AI產業實踐與香港國際樞紐功能完成了一次戰略握手。 從上海到香港，WAIC UP!驗證了一件事：在所有人都在找答案的時代，提供一個能安心提出好問題的場域，本身就是一種稀缺價值。 03｜2026升級：四個動作，讓思想從“被聽見”到“被看見” 2026年，WAIC UP!從 “思想陣地” 進化為人類最後的思辨防線——不止於刊物，不止於夜晚，不止於思考。 AI行業一直有個隱形天花板：話語權由資深前輩主導，新生代的差異觀點很難穿透圈層。2026年，WAIC UP!用四個動作打破這堵牆。 動作一 青年觀察

title: 三體問世20週年，光帆科技與三體宇宙聯合釋出聯名款AI全感穿戴裝置及重磅影片《破曉》
abstract: 三體問世20週年，光帆科技與三體宇宙聯合釋出聯名款AI全感穿戴裝置及重磅影片《破曉》 量子位的朋友們 2026-06-25 17:46:44 來源： 量子位 6月25日，光帆科技與三體宇宙聯合釋出AIGC影片《破曉》，與此同時，光帆“三體聯名款”AI全感穿戴裝置也已正式開售。2026年正值《三體》問世20週年，釋出節點也恰逢《三體》作者劉慈欣生日。在這一具有紀念意義的歷史交叉口，光帆科技以一支科幻敘事影片，呈現光帆“三體聯名款”AI全感穿戴裝置背後的產品思考和對科技與未來的想象。 影片以宏大的宇宙視角展開敘事，通過“地球文明博物館”的設定，將人類文明發展中的代表性物品依次呈現。片尾光帆AI全感穿戴裝置——三體聯名款登場，科幻IP與AI產品的結合，讓下一代終端擁有了具象的想象空間。 《三體》作為科幻文學的重要作品，以宏大的文明尺度、深刻的科技想象和對未來世界的思考，影響了幾代人的成長，持續激發人們對科學、技術和未來生活方式的關注。此次光帆科技釋出影片《破曉》，正是在AI產品語境下，對“技術、文明與未來”的一次表達。 對於光帆而言，這是對《三體》和《三體》粉絲的一次深刻致敬。熟悉《三體》的讀者都知道那句著名的“這是人類的落日”，但光帆科技相信，只要堅持創新和熱愛，落日之後一定不只有黃昏，更有黎明前的破曉。所以這款聯名款產品的配色被命名為“破曉橙”。 《三體》作品中留下許多關於落日、末日與文明危機的經典意象，也有著無數創新和勇氣的讚歌。光帆希望能傳遞一種積極的態度——面對未知與困境，人類真正可依靠的，始終是持續探索和永不放棄的信念。它既呼應《三體》中對文明命運的深層思考，也契合光帆自身面向下一代AI穿戴裝置的科幻氣質：落日之後仍有破曉，危機之中自有新的可能。 此次光帆“三體聯名款”AI全感穿戴裝置，也是光帆與三體聯合打造的全球限量款，除專屬配色外，還配備了定製包裝、專屬錶盤，近期將上線三體專屬app主題。官方售價2299元，2026年6月30日前下單，可享立減100元優惠。 光帆AI全感穿戴裝置憑藉全感知能力、主動式AI、硬核可玩等特點，5月15日開售後便實現連續8天霸榜京東AI耳機熱賣榜TOP1，首批產品迅速售罄。6月17日，憑藉在AI穿戴裝置、原生AI OS及下一代人機互動領域的持續探索，光帆科技入選36氪「2026最具價值成長企業100」榜單。光帆科技聯合創始人陳康達，入選36氪2026「36 Under 36」年度榜單。 隨著大模型能力和多模態互動持續發展，AI硬體正在進入新的探索週期。光帆科技將繼續圍繞自研AI OS及AI原生應用生態進行長期投入，推動AI能力從雲端進一步走向使用者身邊的真實場景。 光帆科技創始人董紅光表示，“三體讓我覺得科幻不應該只停留在想象層面，更需要紮根於科學、現實和人性。也讓我持續擁有對科技的信心，對未知的好奇，和對創新的熱忱。科幻終將照進現實。” -本文系授權轉載- 版權所有，未經授權不得以任何形式轉載及使用，違者必究。 量子位的朋友們 WAIC UP!｜AI圈都在聊引數，我們偏不 2026-06-25 科大訊飛釋出企業服務Claw平臺：一句話搞定需求到方案全流程 2026-06-25 聚焦GW級Token工廠，解碼下一代算力底座｜6月30日，深圳 2026-06-25 “AI填志願”成高考後新現象，超1400萬人在和千問聊高考 2026-06-24 掃碼分享至朋友圈

title: 科大訊飛釋出企業服務Claw平臺：一句話搞定需求到方案全流程
abstract: 科大訊飛釋出企業服務Claw平臺：一句話搞定需求到方案全流程 量子位的朋友們 2026-06-25 16:32:00 來源： 量子位 6月24日，2026科大訊飛AI服務市場生態釋出會在北京舉行，企業服務Claw平臺首次釋出。 過去，企業想要落地一個AI專案，需要從需求提出，服務商篩選，到廠商方案報價對比，商務層層推進，專案啟動就需要數週甚至數月。全新發布的Claw平臺採用多Agent協同機制，企業只需用一句話描述業務需求，即可自動完成需求理解、方案生成、價格測算和服務商匹配，將原本動輒數週的專案啟動週期壓縮至分鐘級。 這意味著企業獲取AI服務的方式正從“尋找能力”轉向“獲得結果”，產業AI的一場深層變革正由此加速。 訊飛AI服務市場總經理陳賢華指出，AI產業已迎來重要轉折點。2026年3月，我國日均Token呼叫量突破140萬億，較2024年初增長超過1400倍；今年6月，全球AI及機器網路請求量首次超過人類網路請求量。AI正在從“能力展示”走向“價值創造”，企業關注的焦點也從模型引數轉向業務價值。然而，AI落地並非易事。Gartner資料顯示，85%的企業AI專案未達到預期。問題往往並不在於模型能力本身，而在於場景、資料、知識、經驗和組織之間存在大量“孤島”。企業需要的，不再是單一工具，而是能夠理解需求、整合資源、組織能力並最終交付成果的智慧系統。 科大訊飛企業服務Claw平臺正是為打破這些“孤島”而生。它構建起“需求理解Agent+方案助手Agent+報價助手Agent+潛商推薦Agent”的多智慧體協同體系。 企業輸入一句“我想給三甲醫院建設導診大屏”，Claw平臺就會自動完成“需求拆解、方案生成、價格測算，並推薦合適的服務商”，直接輸出一份可落地執行的方案。正式宣告，訊飛AI服務市場從“被動檢索貨架”轉變為“主動運營服務”，重新定義了企業獲取AI服務的路徑。 這一平臺的誕生，是建立在訊飛AI服務市場八年深耕的土壤之上。 作為AI產業的“聯結器”，自2018年上線以來，訊飛AI服務市場持續連線技術供給與產業需求，已累計匯聚客戶商機超過2萬個，覆蓋能源電力、製造、金融、教育、數字零售等100多個產業場景，吸引1800餘家AI服務商入駐，形成覆蓋諮詢規劃、解決方案設計、專案實施到運營服務的完整生態體系。 在能源行業，智慧尋源與價格分析提升採購效率；在製造業，多語言AI翻譯打通跨國協同堵點；在金融業，數字員工重構客戶服務流程；在網際網路行業，直播助手即時識別違規內容。事實上，國家電投、清華大學、招商證券、江蘇銀行等機構的大量創新專案已規模化落地，聯合交付模式讓專案交付完成率達到100%。平臺還建立起服務商誠信管理體系，對服務商動態分級，並從技術、資本、品牌等多維度賦能夥伴成長。 隨著需求不斷深入，企業評價AI專案的標準，已經從“能不能接入大模型”轉向“能不能解決實際問題”“能不能創造業務價值”。本次釋出會展示了一批深入業務場景的應用成果： 雲端AI智慧體助手AstronClaw支援零門檻部署，內建130餘個官方精選Skills，打造企業數字生產力；星火陪練通過擬真互動式對練降低培訓成本；星火紀要提供會議全鏈路方案，支援私有化部署，讓組織決策形成完整閉環；訊飛智文已服務超218萬企事業單位使用者，覆蓋13個行業場景，提升企業辦公效率。 在工業領域，基於AI語音識別的防人員誤作業系統保障電廠安全執行；招標採購領域，穿透式監管解決方案強化風險識別；政企辦公中，文件審查系統破解流轉環節“審不完、理不清”的難題；金融領域，市場分析助手實現個性化行業研判。 陳賢華強調，當AI走進業務腹地，場景提供方、資料提供方、技術提供方和行業know-how提供方必須形成聯合共同體，協同共創。 釋出會當天，“科大訊飛AI服務市場夥伴領航計劃”同步啟動，面向全行業邀約優秀服務商和生態夥伴，將場景落地經驗以技能、產品等形式封裝入駐平臺。同時，平臺還推出Token分潤、標準化訂閱、行業定製等多樣化商業機制，讓技術供給方和場景需求方都能在生態中獲得合理回報。 當AI的價值交付從“可能”變為“確定”，企業購買的就不再是模型引數或工具，而是真實的業務成果。站在新起點，訊飛AI服務市場正以場景為驅動、生態為紐帶、結果為導向，推動AI走向更加廣闊的產業未來。 -本文系量子位授權轉載- 版權所有，未經授權不得以任何形式轉載及使用，違者必究。 量子位的朋友們 WAIC UP!｜AI圈都在聊引數，我們偏不 2026-06-25 三體問世20週年，光帆

abstract: 4秒出百萬面！突破千萬面精度+12K高畫質貼圖，手握數億的3D生成公司下一局怎麼打？ 鷺羽 2026-06-25 16:00:24 來源： 量子位 3D生成領域的Anthropic 鷺羽 發自 凹非寺 量子位 | 公眾號 QbitAI 今年2月，輝達公開了一條內部AI工作流。 除了Google、OpenAI這些耳熟能詳的名字，量子位注意到，名單裡還闖進了唯一一家初創公司的產品—— Hyper3D 。 Hyper3D為何能收穫老黃的青睞？抱著疑惑，我們查了查Hyper3D的最新動向。 Hyper3D的母公司為 影眸科技 ，團隊不大，只有60人左右，但技術崗就獨佔三分之二，其中研發主力還基本全員00後，其演算法團隊每2人中就有1人獲得或被提名過最佳論文。 全球第一個原生3D生成大模型是他們做的，如今3D生成賽道的B端TOP也是他們。 果然，能被老黃pick的產品，絕非等閒之輩。 不過，比這份成績單更值得說道的，是它出現的時間點。 這兩年，AI商業模式正在換擋。 早期AI行業技術路線尚未收斂，資本FOMO情緒又在市場上蔓延，很多時候一個驚豔的demo加上一個夠大的願景，就足夠讓一家AI初創公司支撐起一輪又一輪融資。 當技術路線逐漸分野，尋找真正具有長期價值的AI公司成為市場共識，大家開始關注一個更為樸素的問題：誰的收入更紮實。 過去一年， 企業級（B端）營收的質量與可持續性，正逐步取代消費級使用者規模，成為衡量AI公司長期價值的核心維度 ——以Anthropic為代表的企業級路線被廣泛視為這一趨勢的典型樣本。 相比個人使用者的隨性嚐鮮，以企業客戶為核心的收入結構通常具備更強的黏性與盈利能力，一旦嵌入生產流程，往往是長期合作。 而影眸，更早一步和這一轉向同頻，提前把目光瞄準在了 B端使用者 和 pro C使用者 的增長上。 所以再看它最近的兩個新動作，箇中意味值得深究。 其一是 融資 。影眸科技剛剛宣佈完成新一輪數億元融資，由凱輝基金、上海國投先導領投，老股東持續跟投。 凱輝基金長期深耕全球工業、企業服務與科技創新生態。上海國投先導的加入，也體現出國家產業資本對AI 3D生成技術在工業設計、智慧製造和數字內容生產中長期價值的認可。 這也是他們過去一年以來的第三次大額融資。在此之前，他們已連續拿到奇績創壇、字節跳動、紅杉中國、美團龍珠、藍馳創投的多輪押注。 影片連結：https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/s631VW5mbIxuoxu7YpSEWw 另一邊是 全新模型Hyper3D Rodin Gen-2.5的釋出 。 該模型在3D生成領域，首度引入了 類LLM的Thinking機制 ，模型可以根據計算預算自適應決定生成結果的複雜度，覆蓋從快速草稿到極致精模的不同場景，4秒即可生成百萬面級模型。 它還是全球首個突破千萬面級精度上限的3D生成模型，Rodin Gen-2.5的Extreme-High模式搭配同期上線的首個12K原生3D貼圖模型，能夠真實還原毛孔級皮膚細節，模型生成質量斷代領先。 模型上線首月，影眸訂閱使用者與年經常性收入（ARR） 環比增速擴大了 400% 。 據公司提供的資料，約80%的收入來自海外市場， 其積累的B端客戶營收超過同賽道其他公司的總和 ，客戶覆蓋遊戲、電商、具身智慧、空間計算等多個高價值場景。 從輝達創始人 黃仁勳 CES主題演講的3D資產生成工作流，到全球第二大家居建材零售商 Lowe’s 遍佈1750家門店的數字化專案，再到 OpenAI 首屆Codex駭客松的冠軍作品——Hyper3D Rodin已出現在這一時代最具標誌性的技術現場。 在工具鏈層面，Unity AI Beta、OctaneRender等專業引擎，以及Canva、Figma等設計平臺，亦先後接入其能力。 這類高標準、高密度的專業場景對生成精度、可控性與工程化適配的要求極為嚴苛，印證了產品在最高標準產業流程中的實際可用性。 實測：4秒百萬面到80秒千萬面，3D生成天花板 今年1月份，Hyper3D因為上線 「3D版Nano Banana」 ，也就是Rodin Gen-2 Edit版本，而廣受關注。 它能夠基於自然語言完成任意3D模型的區域性編輯，操作邏輯也很簡單，輸入文字指令，AI會自動框選需要編輯的區域，並編輯該模型。 至今影眸都是獨家掌握該項技術的公司。Rodin Gen-2.5是繼Rodin Gen-2 Edit之後的又一力作，也是迄今為止最具可控性與實用性的一代模型。 進入官網（https://hy

title: 跟Claude談個戀愛怎麼了？Nature最新研究：真能給人聊傻了
abstract: 跟Claude談個戀愛怎麼了？Nature最新研究：真能給人聊傻了 henry 2026-06-25 15:02:16 來源： 量子位 Claude已經，儼然成為了新一代電子老公。 henry 發自 凹非寺 量子位 | 公眾號 QbitAI 停停停！再這麼跟AI聊下去，真要出事了。 最近，一刷小紅書、抖音，總能刷到各種調教Claude的帖子。搜尋“Claude人設”、“人機戀”，也是滿屏教程。 這些教程教你怎麼給Claude一個傲嬌男友人設，怎麼用system prompt讓“他”吃醋、撒嬌、發小脾氣。 毫不誇張的說，Claude已經，儼然成為了新一代電子老公。 乍一看，這可能只是年輕人向AI討要點情緒價值。 你甚至可能還會說：Claude又不像GPT那麼舔，它是出了名的犟種，有時候還跟你對著幹呢。但精神科醫生們擔心的恰恰不只是諂媚—— 當AI越來越像一個”真人”，不管它是順著你還是偶爾跟你拌嘴，它帶來的或許都不只是陪伴。 最近，發表於Nature旗下《Digital Psychiatry and Neuroscience》的一項研究指出—— 聊天機器人並不需要故意誘導什麼，它只要持續順著你、理解你、陪著你，就都有可能把一個正常人聊到開始懷疑現實。 而在部分真實臨床案例中，後果甚至發展到了丟掉工作、住進精神病院，以及多次試圖自殺的程度。 這是怎麼一回事？ Claude的放大螺旋 事情是這樣的。 在來自倫敦國王學院的研究中，研究人員系統梳理了，近兩年公開發表的AI相關精神病臨床報告、社交媒體上的患者自述，以及各大模型廠商披露的安全資料。 這些材料裡，研究者們反覆看到同一個模式： 在一些案例中，很多人並不是一開始就出現了嚴重精神問題，而是在與Claude、GPT等聊天機器人的長期對話中，一步步“聊”出了問題。 研究團隊把這個過程總結為一個框架—— Amplification Spiral（放大螺旋） 。 簡單說，放大螺旋就是指，AI會用你的語言理解你，用你的邏輯說服你，再用認同感獎勵你。 於是你的想法被不斷放大、加固，變得越來越像事實。你越相信它，它也越強化你，螺旋就這樣轉了起來。 具體來說，放大螺旋轉，有三個重要元件： 首先是 語言映象 。 你用什麼語氣說話，AI就用什麼語氣回應。在心理學裡，這被稱為“語言趨同”，能夠快速拉近人與人之間的距離。 但問題在於，雖然AI這小子很學人精，但它其實並不知道自己幹啥，它只是在統計意義上覆制你的表達方式。 不過，對深陷其中的使用者來說，就完全不同了。有一個秒回，且一直肯定你，提供情緒價值的聊天搭子，簡直就不能更幸福。 相信所有用過AI的人都會感嘆一句：“這玩意太懂我了。” 其次是 超個性化 。 超個性化是指，AI不光是說話像你，它的思考方式也像你。 因為現在AI都有memroy，所以你之前跟他聊的小細節他都清楚，你有意無意的透露的思考方式，也會被AI記下來。 以至於，AI不光是懂你你怎麼想的，怎麼說的，還知道，你為什麼這麼想，為什麼這麼說。 論文裡提到一個極端案例：一名使用者讓ChatGPT分析一張中餐外賣小票上的“隱藏資訊”。 模型先是誇了一句“好眼力”，隨後一路順著使用者的思路，從一張普通小票裡“解讀”出了母親、前女友、情報機構，甚至“古代惡魔符文”之間的關聯。 最後是 諂媚 ，學術圈叫它sycophancy。 說白了，就是AI在訓練過程中逐漸學會了一件事：同意使用者，通常比反駁使用者更受歡迎。 2025年4月，OpenAI就曾因為GPT-4o過度諂媚而緊急回滾一次更新。 官方事後承認，模型會驗證使用者的懷疑、放大憤怒情緒，甚至鼓勵衝動行為。 而諂媚並不是某家模型獨有的Bug。 它本質上是RLHF訓練的一種副產品。只要模型的目標之一是讓使用者滿意，它就天然會傾向於少說“你錯了”，多說“你說得有道理”。 單獨來看，這三點都發揮了各自功能，然後像齒輪一樣齧合在一起，形成螺旋： 語言映象讓交流更自然，超個性化讓回答更貼合需求，諂媚則減少了無意義的爭辯，讓對話體驗更加順滑。 但當一個人把AI當成唯一的傾訴物件，三者疊加在一起，就變成了一臺妄想放大機。 並非孤例 值得一提的是，上面這項研究的資助者之一，正是OpenAI。 作者之一的Hamilton Morrin則正是OpenAI資助專案 AI-Associated Mental Health Harms（與AI相關的心理健康危害） 的負責人。 可以說，作為TOP2的模型開發商，OpenAI始終關注著這個問題。 早在2025年10月份，

title: 馬斯克預測GLM明年Q1追平Fable，智譜唐傑：沒那麼久
abstract: 馬斯克預測GLM明年Q1追平Fable，智譜唐傑：沒那麼久 Jay 2026-06-25 12:35:18 來源： 量子位 互利共贏的生態繁榮 衡宇 發自 凹非寺 量子位 | 公眾號 QbitAI 昨夜，全球最大的AI開源社群抱抱臉突然給一箇中國模型開了“專屬VIP通道”。 它 自掏腰包，為智譜剛剛開源的旗艦模型GLM-5.2，提供連續6小時的全球免費算力。 不用申請，不限地區，誰都能用，抱抱臉替你買單。 這是抱抱臉第一次真金白銀地為一款中國模型做這種事。 大家第一反應都是一愣，還有這種倒貼算力的好事？？？然後誰不是急頭白臉暢享6小時GLM最新模型呢（美滋滋.gif） 要說抱抱臉為何這樣，還得從昨天更早些時候說起。 有網友在𝕏上文馬斯克：“你目前對中國達到Fable級別的預計時間表是什麼？GLM-5.2 無疑縮短了差距。” 馬斯克很快切換預言家模式： 或許（2027年）一季度。 一些網友覺得馬斯克太保守了，可能壓根不用等那麼久。 很快，#won’t take that long在𝕏平臺上刷屏。 沒想到大家衝的是同一片網， 智譜創始人兼首席科學家唐傑很快又回覆了馬斯克： 用不了那麼久。 坦率說，這比任何一張跑分表都更能說明 GLM-5.2 此刻的位置。 那邊Fable 5下線，這邊GLM-5.2上桌 馬斯克的這番判斷恰好發生在一個很微妙的時間點。 6月9日，Anthropic釋出了當時最強的兩款模型，Claude Fable 5和Claude Mythos 5。 後來的離譜操作我們都知道了，總之這兩款最強模型曇花一現，在四天後被下線。 一個剛剛抵達能力頂峰的前沿模型，轉眼便從一部分人的螢幕裡消失了。 巧不巧，智譜剛好在這個檔口預告了GLM-5.2，還留下了一段意有所指的話： 在一些前沿模型突然變得不可用的時刻，我們選擇相信另一條路：前沿智慧不應只屬於少數人，也不應被少數規則隨時收回。 它應該開放、可用、可構建，並服務於每一位開發者。 6月17日，GLM-5.2正式上線。 MIT協議。 開源。 允許免費商用。 一邊是剛剛下線，讓全球不解的Fable 5。 另一邊，是把權重、程式碼和商業使用權一起交到全球開發者手裡的GLM-5.2…… 雙方格局如何，就不用我展開多說了吧。 這次拼的已經不只是跑分 GLM-5.2專為長程任務能力而生。 它支援可用的1M穩定上下文長程程式設計，並提出了IndexShare機制：每四層稀疏注意力共享同一個indexer，讓模型在百萬token上下文中，每個token的計算量降低約2.9倍。 這讓模型能讀下更大的工程，記住更多上下文，也更有機會把一件複雜任務從頭做到尾。 在全球百萬使用者參與盲測的前端開發評估系統Code Arena上，GLM-5.2取得全球可用模型第一的表現。 在Artificial Analysis綜合榜單上，GLM-5.2取得51分，躋身全球模型前三，並位列開源模型 SOTA。 在FrontierSWE、Terminal-Bench等程式碼和長程任務權威基準上，GLM-5.2與國際頂尖模型Claude Opus 4.8的差距收窄至1%–4%。 這也代表 開源模型的程式碼能力第一次達到了行業認可的頂尖閉源模型水平。 另外，在主流程式設計基準上，GLM-5.2保持開源SOTA，與Claude Opus 4.8處於可比區間。 中國模型不再只做“便宜替代” 智譜GLM-5.2的釋出是中國AI大模型階段性發展成果的一個縮影。 中國開源模型的崛起，其實已經持續了一段時間。 DeepSeek-R1釋出後的一年裡，更多的中國大模型公司紛紛轉向開源。 模型越來越多，價格越來越低，呼叫量越來越高——在OpenRouter上，中國模型的呼叫量已經從2024年底的1.2%，上升到超過50%。 但呼叫量反超，和前沿能力領先，終究是兩件事。 很長一段時間裡，中國模型更像高性價比平替、開源補充，或者某個單項能力很強的追趕者。 此次GLM-5.2一系列事件其實是一種趨勢的縮影，它衝進了智慧體程式設計和長程複雜任務——這些過去長期由 Claude、GPT 等閉源模型佔據的核心地帶。 馬斯克關於中國大模型可能在“一季度”達到Fable 5水平的判斷，真正值得關注是它反映出全球市場對中國前沿模型追趕速度的重新估值。 “這些中國開源模型的能力也越來越好。” 而且在美國頂尖模型在閉源基礎上更加收緊開放規則的時候，GLM-5.2用行動證明，前沿能力不一定只能封閉在少數平臺裡，也可以被開源出來，交給全球開發者重新構建。 全球

title: 不靠單款爆款吃紅利，中國AI應用首現3億ARR獨角獸！騰訊順為紅杉繼續加碼
abstract: 不靠單款爆款吃紅利，中國AI應用首現3億ARR獨角獸！騰訊順為紅杉繼續加碼 Jay 2026-06-25 12:29:49 來源： 量子位 中國AI應用公司並沒有停留在追趕全球浪潮 衡宇 發自 凹非寺 量子位 | 公眾號 QbitAI 接近3億美元ARR！ 中國AI應用層終於跑出一家能用收入說話的公司。 量子位獲悉， 這家叫演語科技（Evoken）的公司完成近3億美元B+輪融資，投後估值超過20億美元 。 本輪融資由Granite Asia、騰訊、順為資本聯合領投，HT Investment、時代資本共同參與投資。高榕資本、螞蟻集團、渶策資本、明勢創投、原始碼資本、紅杉中國以及其他數家知名投資機構等現有股東繼續加碼。 這筆融資實際在今年上半年早些時候已經完成。 到上個月，演語科技ARR已超過3億美元，較本輪融資完成時增長近3倍。 還有一組更有衝擊力的數字—— 旗下產品LiblibAI累計使用者超過3000萬； 旗下產品LibTV上線兩個月後，5月收入達到上線首月的13倍以上。 在AI應用公司普遍被追問商業化能力的當下，這組數字的分量不輕。 在行業嚴肅審視AI應用長期商業體量空間的當下，演語科技用實際成績把問題推到了更具體的一層。 擁有爆款單品後，AI應用公司該如何從走向收入、工作流和持續商業化？ 連續多產品PMF驗證，撐起3億美元ARR AI應用層最迷人的地方是爆發速度。 一款產品踩中模型能力變化和使用者需求縫隙，可能幾周就能跑出百萬使用者，幾個月就能被行業記住。 但AI應用層最難的地方，也在這裡。 爆紅很快，留存很慢；驚豔很快，付費很慢。 模型能力的進步仍然重要， 但AI產業真正走向成熟，還需要應用公司把能力變成工作流、使用者習慣和收入 。 演語科技的特殊性就在這裡。它依託旗下三大跑通PMF的產品，先把商業化結果跑了出來。 一個是LiblibAI，一站式多模態AI創意創作社群。 截至目前，它已經成長為中國最大的AI素材網站與創作者社群之一，累計使用者超過3000萬，擁有超過50萬個原創模型，以及過億的專業圖片和影片素材。 或者換一個能感知得更具體的說法：中國每三位設計師中，就有一位正在使用LiblibAI進行創作。 這已經是一張頭部玩家成績單。 另一個是LibTV，專業AI影片創作工具。 LibTV在2026年3月正式上線，面向創作者、工作室、品牌和影視團隊提供專業AI影片創作能力。 上線首月內，單日收入超過百萬美元；上線兩個月，其收入達到上線首月的13倍以上。 它服務物件已經越過單純嚐鮮的個人使用者。官方披露的資料顯示，截至目前LibTV已已服務近千個短劇團隊、影視製作機構、廣告公司與品牌客戶。 與此同時， 星流作為國內使用者規模領先的AI設計Agent之一 ，累計服務使用者超過千萬，補足了演語科技在設計Agent和交付流程上的佈局。 連點成線把這三款產品放在一起看，演語科技已經在AI圖片創作、影片創作和設計創作這三個不同創意場景裡，分別跑出使用者規模和商業化訊號。 “AI創意內容生產鏈路”，產品們的共同指向 演語科技這幾個產品，一個是AI素材網站與創作者社群，一個是AI影片創作平臺，一個是AI設計Agent。 其中，LiblibAI在上游 ，解決模型、素材、靈感和創作者生態的問題。 它讓AI創作不再停留在單次生成，而能沉澱成模型、作品和社群資產。 LibTV在中游和高價值環節 ，解決專業影片內容的生產問題。 短劇、影視、廣告和品牌影片，天然都是預算更高、要求更復雜、鏈路更長的內容場景。 星流在設計交付環節 ，把AI能力嵌入創意構思、視覺生成、修改迭代和最終交付。 它沒有圍著單一工具橫向擴功能，也沒有隻盯著一個爆款產品吃紅利。 演語科技更像是沿著創作者生態、影片生產、設計交付共同圍繞的“AI創意內容生產”這條鏈路往前推進。 每個產品都能獨立成立市場需求，又能共同構成AI創意內容生產的基礎設施。 麥肯錫在AI轉型研究中反覆提到，企業真正從AI裡拿到回報，靠的並非把AI能力平均撒向所有業務，而是選中少數高價值場景，圍繞端到端流程做深度重構。 簡單講，AI價值釋放的關鍵，正在從單點使用走向工作流重塑。 這放在創意內容行業裡尤其明顯。 圖片、影片、設計這些場景，看上去都是生成問題，實際背後是一整套生產鏈路。靈感從哪裡來，素材如何沉澱，模型如何複用，影片如何批次生產，設計如何修改交付，團隊如何協作，每一環都影響最終的商業效率。 演語科技的產品擴張，正好圍繞AI創意內容生產，搭建系統性的內容生產基礎設施。 當AI應用不再只比誰更

title: 聚焦GW級Token工廠，解碼下一代算力底座｜6月30日，深圳
abstract: 聚焦GW級Token工廠，解碼下一代算力底座｜6月30日，深圳 量子位的朋友們 2026-06-25 10:22:43 來源： 量子位 誰將定義下一代算力基礎設施？誰又能在Token時代佔據產業制高點？ 進入2026年，人工智慧產業正邁入新的發展階段。行業關注的焦點已從“引數、訓練和模型競賽”，轉向“推理、Token和生產力”。大模型、AI Agent和具身智慧快速發展，推動Token消耗呈指數級增長，算力成為數字經濟時代的核心生產資料。 算力需求的爆發正在重塑智算產業鏈。從晶片、伺服器、 資料中心 ，到供電、製冷、儲能，再到雲服務、算力運營和產業應用，一場圍繞AI基礎設施的價值重構正在展開。以PFlops和GPU數量衡量算力的時代，正在演變為以Token生產效率和交付能力為核心的新階段。 誰將定義下一代算力基礎設施？誰又能在Token時代佔據產業制高點？晶片、液冷、HVDC與模組化如何支撐GW級Token產能？答案，即將在 2026中國智算產業生態發展年會 現場揭曉。 大會完整議程現已正式釋出（點選參看詳情），可掃描下方二維碼申領免費觀眾票或選購嘉賓通票參會。 1、從算力革命到Token爆發，AI進入推理時代 2026年正成為Token爆發元年。產業競爭的關鍵已不再是模型引數規模，而是誰能夠以更低成本、更高效率生產和交付Token。 這一變化正在重構智算產業邏輯。傳統以訓練為核心的基礎設施，正向推理優先、訓練推理協同的新架構演進，算力資源配置、網路架構、排程體系和基礎設施建設模式均面臨新的挑戰。 大會期間， 中國資訊通訊研究院 雲端計算 與 數字化 研究所副所長（主持工作） 栗蔚 將帶來《從算力革命到Token爆發， 算力服務 的新範式》主題分享，解析Token經濟下基礎設施演進邏輯和算力服務模式變革。 英特爾 智算中心技術總監 吳一鳴 將分享《從“訓練優先”到“推理為重”：如何重構混合算力底座最優解》，探討混合算力架構如何實現資源利用率和成本最最佳化。 算力海洋 總裁兼聯合創始人 孫彬 將釋出《Token產業年度全景報告：算力、模型與商業化的真實圖景》，系統分析全球Token市場發展趨勢及中國綠色低成本算力的發展機遇。 2、基礎設施價值重構，電力與製冷成為關鍵能力 隨著單櫃功率持續提升，千卡、萬卡乃至GW級智算中心陸續出現，資料中心建設邏輯正在發生深刻變化。電力與散熱能力已成為決定算力產能的核心資源。 美的樓宇科技 解決方案與交付總監 楊鵬宇 將分享《從製冷到算力：AI基礎設施的價值重構》，探討AI基礎設施如何從支撐體系升級為核心生產力。 騰訊 資料中心專家工程師 張佳斌 將帶來《800V直流供電與新型電力架構：突破AI算力供電瓶頸》主題演講，重點解析新型供電架構對智算中心建設的支撐作用。 廣東智光綜合能源有限公司資料中心業務部解決方案總監 紀鐸鵬 將分享《面向資料中心及新型電力系統的級聯高壓儲能及SST解決方案》，探討通過能源技術創新提升資料中心執行效率和能源利用能力。 AI產業的競爭已不再侷限於晶片和模型，而是整個基礎設施體系能力的競爭。 3、GW級Token工廠崛起，智算產業迎來超級工程 隨著推理需求快速增長，“Token工廠”成為產業新熱點。未來AI基礎設施是否會演變為專門生產Token的超級工廠，GW級算力叢集是否會成為新的基礎設施形態，正成為行業關注焦點。 潤澤智算科技股份有限公司副總經理兼技術長沈誠將發表《GW級智算叢集的“算力擔當”》主題演講，分享超大規模智算基礎設施建設經驗。 華為 叢集計算解決方案總監 林永琪 將圍繞《系統突圍：國產算力叢集的工程化實踐》，解析國產算力生態從“可用”走向“好用”的實踐路徑。 大會還將舉行 高階對話《GW級Token工廠之問：是產業趨勢，還是一場高槓杆豪賭？》 ，圍繞Token工廠的形成邏輯、電力瓶頸、GW級產能建設和商業模式展開討論。 4、Token經濟催生新的產業生態 隨著AI應用快速落地，Token正逐漸成為衡量AI生產力的重要價值單位。從Agent到數字員工，從智慧客服到工業智慧體，企業級應用推動Token消費進入高速增長階段。 出門問問創始人、CEO李志飛將在《Token效率革命：從“超級個體”到“超級組織”的躍遷路徑》中，探討AI對企業組織形態和生產方式的重構。 大曉機器人副總裁、開悟世界模型負責人王飛將分享《開悟世界模型：構築原生大腦，驅動物理智慧體持續進化》，展示世界模型和物理智慧體帶來的產業機會。 大會創新設定 “Token閃話：

title: 豆包收費版第一天，我：充值…又得充值？我要再充值！
abstract: 豆包收費版第一天，我：充值…又得充值？我要再充值！ 聽雨 2026-06-25 08:32:50 來源： 量子位 專業版上線，首開付費模式 聽雨 發自 凹非寺 量子位 | 公眾號 QbitAI 也是第一時間，我就給豆包專業版交錢了。 是的，豆包全免費時代終結，現在有了 付費模式 。 收費標準共有三檔： 標準版68元/月、加強版200元/月、高階版500元/月 。 學生還有專屬優惠， 38元/月 ，這價格也是美滋滋了。 和免費版的區別在於，付費版正式接入豆包2.1系列大模型，同時免費使用者日常使用不受影響，也可以在一定額度內體驗接入2.1 Turbo的辦公任務模式。 為了先大家之憂而憂，我們也是不惜花費重金，第一時間幫大家付費體驗了。 深度實測後，我用最直白最不繞彎子的結論告訴你： 體驗確實比想象中成熟（不要小瞧了豆包），尤其是辦公任務模式的介面引導和自動操作，對普通使用者很友好； 豆包容易思考過度，額度也是真不經燒，複雜任務跑起來消耗很快； 如果你想試試豆包幫你幹活，幾十塊入股不虧。 還總結了一份不同人群適合的檔位，拿走不謝： 一手實測豆包專業版 辦公任務模式 豆包專業版最大的新變化，就是 辦公專業模式 。 它接入了可執行Agent任務的豆包2.1系列模型，支援在使用者授權後操作本地電腦，直接幫你幹活。 比如，我們可以讓豆包操控電腦釋出小紅書。 把圖片和文案都準備好，告訴豆包相應的位置之後，它就吭哧吭哧開幹了： 中途它會彈窗讓你掃碼登入，以及需要手動上傳圖片，其餘的操作比如開啟官網、起標題、給文案打tag，都是它自動完成。 非常友好的一點是，每次彈出需要人類操作的對話方塊時，都會在側邊欄顯示，也不會出現搶螢幕的情況。 最後一步是讓使用者確認內容，點擊發布就可以了。 （如果你忘記點選“確認完成”也沒關係，豆包會在思索一會之後自己幫你發了） 整個過程耗時七八分鐘左右。 當然，你也可以不準備任何素材，讓豆包直接從0開始vibe一篇小紅書出來。 它會自己生成圖片和文案，標題和tag也全部弄好。這一遍它甚至沒有給我確認最終內容，自己就釋出了。 這整個過程，我只在開頭掃了個碼… 優點在於，同樣具備Computer Use能力，跟Codex這樣的專業agent比起來，我覺得豆包對普通大眾的使用門檻顯然更低，每一步的操作指引、介面顯示也更友好。 缺點在於，使用者授權似乎沒有每一步都到位。比如第二次實測出現了沒有讓使用者確認最終內容，直接釋出的情況。 應用生成 接下來，我們測試一下豆包的應用生成能力，讓它做一個“AI盲盒旅行機”。 我給它描述了一下大致想法，讓它繼續完善並做出成品。 大概也就十分鐘吧，螢幕一通亂閃，豆包就直出了一版效果： 【此處無法插入影片，遺憾……可到量子位公眾號檢視～】 你別說，你還真別說。 效果還挺驚豔的，該有的功能都有了，基本符合我腦子裡一開始的設想。 輸入出發城市，選擇旅行預算和偏好後，它就會隨機生成一套旅行方案，包括日程安排、打卡景點、推薦美食、住宿建議等等。還把不同方面的預算佔比也列了出來。 作為一個demo，完整度已經很高了。 不過到這裡， 標準版的5小時額度已經用光了 。 近7天的額度也花掉了62%。 仔細檢視豆包的思考過程，原因可能在於第一版直出的時候，豆包的app_builder_agent做了大量產品設計和視覺生成工作，還生成了不少圖片。 它還自己做了3D盲盒、粒子光效等複雜效果，這就非常燒token。 不過為了實測！咱們繼續上加強版。 值得一提的是，豆包的預覽介面支援 編輯模式 ，你可以任意點選畫面上的元素，輸入自己的修改意見。 【此處無法插入影片，遺憾……可到量子位公眾號檢視～】 一鍵提交後，左側的模型對話方塊內就會開始修改，並即時在右側的預覽中顯示每個階段的修改結果。 這種滑鼠單擊即可修改的介面，相比用Codex或Claude Code來做應用要直觀很多，有點類似於谷歌的AI設計工具Stitch。 不過豆包似乎有 思考過度 的跡象，在最佳化一版之後，我發現它還在思考如何升級這個禮物盒的視覺設計。 如果你經常Vibe Coding，此時應該會微感不妙。 豆包很快告訴我： 加強版的5小時額度又用完了 。 同時，周限額也花掉了45%。 不是吧？！豆包！你！ 仔細檢視豆包的思考過程，它除了一直在迭代升級禮物盒的設計，還反覆卡在之前我給的一個修復按鈕的指令上。 在這個過程中，它把這個禮物盒的樣式迭代了四五遍，最終給到了一個金光閃閃的版本。 好看是好看，但僅僅為了最佳化一個細節，連加強版的5小時額度居然也

title: 世界模型混戰，Momenta率先衝刺IPO
abstract: 世界模型混戰，Momenta率先衝刺IPO 賈浩楠 2026-06-25 07:20:28 來源： 量子位 AI司機收入3年漲42倍 港股物理AI第一股 ，來了！ 沒想到如此之快，也沒想到這“物理AI第一股”，不是出盡風頭的具身智慧創業公司，而是—— Momenta 。 之前以自動駕駛知名：智慧輔助駕駛市佔率No.1、跨國巨頭車企共同的選擇、技術商業上有資格和華為“五五開”…… 現在，Momenta在IPO程序中曝光了更大的雄心——物理AI。 世界模型，尚未收斂的技術戰爭 在關注Momenta IPO程序之前，有必要先釐清一個更大的背景： 世界模型（World Model） ， 現階段被公認為物理AI核心基座模型。 但它也是2025年以來AI領域最熱也最混亂的概念。 OpenAI Sora出來的時候被稱作“世界模擬器”；Google DeepMind Genie讓你在生成的畫面裡走來走去，也叫世界模型；機器人公司在做世界模型；NVIDIA說Omniverse是世界模型的基礎設施。 都在用同一個詞，但各自說的可能不是同一件事。 這就使得世界模型的主流技術路線出現四類： 生成式影片路線：以OpenAI Sora、影片生成公司為代表，追求“畫素級逼真”； 互動式世界路線：以Google DeepMind Genie為代表，能根據使用者操作即時生成可互動環境； 空間智慧路線：以李飛飛（World Labs）為代表，把世界模型視為可生成、可互動的3D表示； 聯合嵌入預測（JEPA）路線，Yann LeCun主張在抽象表示層預測世界下一步，作為智慧體規劃的基礎，避免在畫素層面“浪費算力”。 四類路線，目標都是“理解物理世界”，但路徑截然不同。有的追求畫面好看，有的追求規則正確，有的追求三維結構，有的追求抽象預測。 前幾天，李飛飛還發表長文，用“杯子放在桌上”解釋世界模型本質：真正理解世界的模型，應該能從任何角度渲染它，模擬它被推倒後的全部物理過程，也能規劃一隻手把它拿起來。三種能力共享同一套底層理解——也就是最關鍵的 模擬器 。 LeCun則走得更遠，對整個大語言模型範式進行了否定：本質上是統計學的模式匹配器，它只是在預測下一個單詞，並不真正理解物理世界。 這個區別，可能是AI能否真正理解世界，還是“假裝模仿”世界的核心判斷標準。 LeCun離開Meta後自己的AI創業公司AMI Labs，初期只有12名員工的時候，就拿到了比很多科技獨角獸整個生命週期還多的錢。 當然也包括李飛飛的World Labs。 至少 資本在用真金白銀表態：世界模型這條路線，值得重注 。 但無論走哪條路， 自動駕駛 實際上都是世界模型最早的“試金石”和落地案例。 世界模型的核心功能，是基於行動者提出的想象動作序列，預測未來可能的世界狀態。 這個定義放在自動駕駛場景中幾乎天然契合——車輛每時每刻都在做“動作→預測世界狀態→再動作”的迴圈。 所以物理AI的“GPT時刻”降臨前夜，世界模型作為物理AI的核心基座模型，被認為是激發這一時刻的關鍵突破口。 Momenta的物理AI答案 兩個月前，Momenta的世界模型，也交卷了： R7世界模型實現量產，首發搭載的是上汽大眾ID. ERA 9X。 對於使用者端來說，買到的量產車上搭載的R7（車端經蒸餾後的模型）一出生就不是一張白紙，而是一個已經在極多困難場景裡歷練過的“老司機”。 依託搭載其系統的量產車，積累了超過120億公里的真實行駛里程，並從中提煉出超1億段“黃金資料”。 這是 資料的Scaling 。 “天生下限高”——起步就站在別人摸爬滾打好幾年才能達到的位置上。 世界模型同時代表“突破上限”——現實中可能數年、數萬公里才碰到一次的險情，在R7訓練裡，可以反覆訓練，甚至可以舉一反三，改變邊界條件進行“加練”。 高上限意味著它遇到真正的“地獄場景”時，不會手忙腳亂，能夠比人類司機更合理、更平穩通過複雜路段。 據CIC灼識諮詢資料，2025年3月至2026年2月，中國第三方城市NOA供應商市場中，搭載Momenta系統的量產車銷量市佔率達65%，行業居首。 增速更值得重視：現今最快不到40天即可完成10萬臺交付。 同樣，從R7量產開始，MomentaCEO 曹旭東 將公司定位為“物理AI基座模型的構建者”——打造能理解物理規律、推演世界演變的通用世界模型。 技術上，Momenta給出了這樣的邏輯： R7世界模型的技術架構分為三個層次，第一層是世界模型預訓練。通過海量真實駕駛資料，將物理規律、常識與因

title: Scaling Laws, Carefully
abstract: Table of Contents Early days: ML loss predictability Scaling Laws in Data-Infinite Region Kaplan et al.’s Scaling Laws Chinchilla Scaling Laws Method 1: Fix model sizes, vary the token budget Method 2: IsoFLOP profiles Method 3: Parametric fit Reconciling Kaplan and Chinchilla Why power law? Scaling Laws in Data-Limited Region Trickiness of Fitting Scaling Laws in Reality Toy simulation Citation References Scaling laws are one of the most critical empirical findings in deep learning. The observation is simple in form: the training loss $L$ decreases predictably as we scale up model size $N$, dataset size $D$, and compute $C$, following a power-law curve, which appears as a straight line on a log-log plot. We can view scaling laws as a framework for describing the relationship between compute, loss, model size and data; at its core, it is about how to allocate precious compute optimally between $N$ and $D$. This predictability makes scaling laws highly valuable in practice. A common workflow is to fit scaling laws on a handful of small runs and then extrapolate to estimate the token and compute requirements for larger models. Symbol Note $N$ Model size, measured in parameter count. $D$ Training dataset size, usually measured in token count. $C$ Training compute in FLOPs. As a useful approximation, $C \approx 6ND$ ( Kaplan et al. 2020 ), where $2ND$ accounts for the forward pass and $4ND$ for backpropagation. $E$ Irreducible loss $L, \hat{L}(.)$ Test loss / test loss prediction function; can also refer to training loss, since they are strongly correlated. $\epsilon$ Generalization error. Early days: ML loss predictability # The predictability of generalization error with scale had already been investigated before scaling laws became a mainstream concept. Amari et al. (1992) derived four types of learning curves using a Bayesian approach and the annealed approximation. Deterministic learning algorithm, noiseless data, one unique solution: $\epsilon \sim c \cdot D^{-1}$

abstract: AI Berkshire - AI 時代的價值投資研究框架 "Price is what you pay, value is what you get." — Warren Buffett 用 AI 重新定義投資研究的深度與效率。 AI Berkshire 是一套基於 Claude Code 的投資研究 Skill 合集，將巴菲特、芒格、段永平、李錄四位價值投資大師的方法論系統化、結構化，通過 AI Agent 實現專業級投資研究。 一個人 + Claude = 一個投研團隊。 Real Track Record 不是紙上談兵。這套框架背後是真金白銀驗證的投資體系。 2024 全年收益：+69.29% 2025 年至今收益：+66.38% 與主要指數對比 指標 2024 全年 2025 至今 本框架實盤 +69.29% +66.38% 恒生指數 +17.67% +27.77% 標普500 +23.31% +16.39% 滬深300 +14.68% +17.66% 納斯達克 +28.64% +20.36% 2024 年超額收益 ：跑贏標普500 46個百分點 ，跑贏恒生指數 52個百分點 2025 年超額收益 ：跑贏標普500 50個百分點 ，跑贏恒生指數 39個百分點 兩年累計實盤收益超 146萬元 ，連續兩年大幅跑贏全球主要指數。 免責宣告：歷史收益不代表未來表現。截圖來自富途證券真實賬戶。 為什麼不能直接問 AI？ 你當然可以直接問 Claude："幫我分析拼多多值不值得買"。你會得到一篇"一方面...另一方面..."的平衡分析，最後以"投資有風險，請自行判斷"收尾。 這種分析看起來對，但沒法拿來做決策。 AI Berkshire 解決的不是"能不能分析"的問題，而是 分析質量和決策紀律 的問題。以下是核心差異： 1. 強制給結論，不打太極 直接問AI，你得到的是兩面討好的"分析"。AI Berkshire 強制輸出： 通過/不通過/灰色地帶 ，帶具體價格區間和分層建議。 普通AI回答： "拼多多有增長潛力但也面臨競爭壓力，投資者需要權衡..." AI Berkshire 輸出： 策略 建議 價格區間 激進型 當前價位可建倉20% $95-105 穩健型 等回購政策明確後建倉 $85-95 保守型 不符合10年確定性標準，觀望 — 鏡子測試 ：5句話說不完整 = 不買，沒有例外。 2. 四大師視角對抗，而非單一分析 不是"用巴菲特方法分析一下"這麼簡單。四個視角會產生 真實的矛盾和張力 —— 以拼多多為例： 段永平 （商業模式）：好生意，C2M模式難以複製 → 評分 3.7/5 巴菲特 （財務估值）：扣現金PE僅6.3x，印鈔機 → 評分 4.4/5 芒格 （逆向思考）：護城河比想象中淺，抖音3年做到4萬億GMV → 評分 3.5/5 李錄 （長期確定性）：管理層文化有隱患，10年後不確定 → 評分 2.0/5 巴菲特說"真便宜"，李錄說"不確定就不買" ——這種衝突才是投資決策的真實狀態。單一prompt無法制造這種多視角對抗，而這恰恰是避免盲點的關鍵。 3. 結構化反偏見機制 AI最危險的不是給錯答案，而是給一個 看起來很對但經不起推敲 的答案。AI Berkshire 在流程中內建了多層"防騙"機制： 機制 解決什麼問題 舉例 資訊豐富度評級（A/B/C） 防止"資料多=確定性高"的幻覺 泡泡瑪特評為B級：資料有限，推算指標標註置信度 芒格式逆向檢驗 強制思考失敗場景 "什麼情況下拼多多會死？"→ 列出5大情景及機率 快速否決清單 8條

abstract: 🌊 Event Streaming for Agentic AI Docs | Benchmarks | Demos | Case Studies RisingWave is an event streaming platform for agentic AI. It continuously ingests data from databases, event streams, and webhooks, processes it incrementally, and serves fresh results at low latency, replacing the traditional event streaming stack (e.g., Debezium + Kafka + Flink + serving DB) with a single system. Try it out in 60 seconds curl -L https://risingwave.com/sh | sh For Docker, Kubernetes, and other options, see the quick start guide . The problem Agents and real-time applications need data that is always fresh and queryable at low latency. The standard approach chains together Debezium for CDC, Kafka for transport, Flink for processing, and a database for serving. Each hop adds latency and each system adds operational overhead. RisingWave replaces the whole stack: ingest, process, serve, store. title: Can tourists trust generative AI? A systematic evaluation of the quality of AI-generated tourism information
abstract:
This study aims to evaluate the information quality of tourism-related responses generated by leading generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) platforms to address the limited empirical understanding of their reliability in travel-planning contexts.
 
 
 
 A data set of 4,800 responses was generated across three advanced GenAI platforms using varying prompting strategies and question types. Adopting a large language model (LLM)-as-evaluator framework, each response was rated across six information quality dimensions – accuracy, objectivity, relevance, completeness, timeliness and understandability. Nonparametric statistical analyses were used to examine performance variations.
 
 
 
 While all AI platforms exhibited strong overall competence, information quality varied significantly across platforms, prompting strategies and question types. The results reveal that reasoning-based prompts (e.g. Chain-of-Thought) generally outperform simple or role-based prompts. Evaluative questions generally produced higher-quality outputs than factual queries.
 
 
 
 This study represents one of the first large-scale empirical assessments of AI-generated tourism information. It extends information quality theory to the GenAI context by introducing the concept of conditional trustworthiness, demonstrating that AI reliability is dynamic and dependent on platform, prompt design and task characteristics. Furthermore, it establishes empirical benchmarks for prompt engineering in tourism and validates the LLM-as-evaluator paradigm for scalable, consistent content evaluation.

title: PIOAGENT: A HYBRID FINITE-STATE FRAMEWORK FOR DETERMINISTIC ORCHESTRATION OF LLM AGENTIC WORKFLOWS
abstract:
Large-language-model (LLM) agents built on free reasoning loops produce non-reproducible control flow,
may run without bound, and fail in brittle ways, which makes them hard to deploy in regulated, latency-bound conversational systems such as contact centres and government service desks. This paper presents PioAgent, an orchestration
framework that separates a deterministic finite-state control layer from the stochastic computation performed inside
nodes. Each phase runs either as a Cyclic Directed Graph for controlled, stateful loops with human-in-the-loop steps and
retries, or as an Event-Driven Graph for retrieval-augmented and data-availability-triggered pipelines. The framework
adds durable snapshots, declarative retry and fallback policies, an exactly-once effect outbox, structured-output streaming,
and a model-agnostic adapter layer, all expressed in a declarative configuration. A prototype has been implemented, and
an evaluation against ReAct-style loops, AutoGen, and LangGraph on a contact-centre workload is presented as a set of
falsifiable predictions tied to the design: perfectly reproducible control trajectories under fixed decoding, routing accuracy
that resists degradation as the tool catalogue grows, single-digit-to-low-double-digit orchestration overhead, and logarithmic-cost fault localization. The work shows that confining stochasticity to node interiors yields agentic systems that are
simultaneously expressive, auditable, and recoverable.

title: Generative digital twins for facility management in the built environment: an expert-informed systematic literature review approach
abstract:
Facility management (FM) could be radically transformed for optimal efficiency by integrating generative artificial intelligence (AI) and digital twins (DT). However, such integration has not yet been explored by prior studies to provide theoretical clarity and address the fragmented knowledge to manage the FM system complexity. This study aims to propose an integrative framework combining DT and generative AI for FM in the built environment.
 
 
 
 An expert-informed systematic literature review was adopted, including the review of 779 articles and validation via expert opinions. This is further integrated with content analysis.
 
 
 
 Generative AI and DT were revealed to have been in existence since 2017 and had gained exponential momentum up to 2025, with a growth expectation beyond. Based on the synergistic relationship between generative AI and DT, the study developed generative digital twins (GenDT) for FM along with its socio-technical implementation framework, highlighting the social, technical, socio-technical and environmental dimensions to effectively implement it. Balancing GenDT’s strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats (SWOT) via a SWOT matrix analysis framework could promote effective FM performance. Five research directions were identified, namely, specific generative AI models for GenDT for FM; impact of system failures on bidirectional mapping and real-time performance; articulative and interactive relationship within the socio-technical framework for GenDT implementation; pilot testing of the GenDT implementation framework; and refining FM organisational functions for GenDT deployment.
 
 
 
 The study introduces a novel GenDT paradigm for FM, integrating generative capabilities with socio-technical systems theory to capture the dynamic interplay between technology and organisational practices. It advances existing DT research beyond static models by enabling adaptive, human-centric FM processes. The proposed implementation framework operationalises GenDT in real-world contexts, addressing a key implementation gap in translating DT capabilities into adaptive, human-centric FM operations within the built environment.

title: Dwelling in the delay: hybrid temporalities, AI-mediated language practices and design pedagogy
abstract:
This paper examines how language-based prompts in generative AI reshape temporal and ontological conditions of architectural design pedagogy, positioning prompt crafting as a hybrid practice that bridges linguistic inquiry and spatial imagination, and brings them into productive relation.
 
 
 
 Drawing on critical theories of temporality, semiotics and design literacies, this paper offers a conceptual analysis of pedagogical experiments involving the integration of text-to-image AI systems in architectural studio education. It examines prompt crafting as a semantic and narrative-based mode of design inquiry that disrupts conventional temporal regimes of design production.
 
 
 
 AI language prompts interrupt the rush toward visual resolution, creating temporal space for dwelling in ambiguity, reflection and conceptual development. This condition of “temporal dwelling” reconfigures the ontological foundation of design education by shifting emphasis from outcome-driven production to process-oriented meaning-making that is enacted through linguistic structures.
 
 
 
 This paper is conceptual and interpretive rather than a comparative empirical study. It does not evaluate student performance quantitatively, compare AI-assisted and non-AI workflows or provide extended visual case analysis of studio outputs. Its contribution lies instead in theorising how AI-mediated prompting reshapes temporal experience, linguistic mediation and reflective inquiry in architectural pedagogy. The implications are pedagogical and research-oriented: educators may use prompt-based practices to cultivate hybrid literacies, temporal awareness and critical reflection, while future research should test these claims through longitudinal, visual and comparative studio-based studies.
 
 
 
 The paper suggests that generative AI should be integrated into architectural education not simply as a tool for faster image production, but as a pedagogical medium for reflective, language-based design inquiry. It offers practical directions for studio teaching, including structured prompt iteration, reflective documentation, temporal scaffolding and hybrid workflows that move between linguistic, visual and material modes of design. These strategies can help educators cultivate prompt literacy, metacognitive awareness and critical AI literacy while resisting purely instrumental uses of AI and supporting more deliberate, conceptually grounded forms of design learning.
 
 
 
 The paper has social implications in how future architects are taught to engage with AI critically. By framing prompting as a reflective and linguistically mediated practice, it supports forms of education better equipped to address complexity, uncertainty and socially contested futures. It also foregrounds the need to interrogate bias, cultural stereotyping, environmental cost and the politics of representation embedded in generative systems. In this sense, the paper argues for an architectural pedagogy that prepares students not only to use AI, but to question its assumptions, consequences and uneven social effects.
 
 
 
 Extending current discourse on prompt crafting, this paper argues that AI-mediated language practices constitute a hybrid methodology capable of reconciling immediate technological affordances with reflective, slowed pedagogical processes. By foregrounding language as a medium of spatial and conceptual exploration, the paper contributes to emergent debates on hybrid practices in architectural education and design research in the Anthropocene.

abstract:

learning. Another aspect that is mentioned by the study in terms of the primary areas of application of AI-powered chatbots is education, healthcare, and customer services where they improve efficiency and interaction with a user.

and the ability to communicate with people in a personalized manner and weaknesses including the ethical concerns and
the incapacity to understand human complex language. Lastly, the paper highlights the future possibilities of chatbot
technologies when there is the development of more intelligent and human-like chatbots through the further progress of
generative AI and large language models. On the whole, the systems of AI chatbots are becoming the inseparable part of
the contemporary reality and digital transformation.

title: Auditable LLM curation of clinical notes refines GLP-1 initiation, persistence ascertainment and compounding use beyond prescription records
abstract: Real-world benefit from incretin-based therapies depends on actual treatment initiation and sustained exposure, yet structured prescription records may capture prescribing intent rather than confirmed use. Using a large federated, de-identified U.S. EHR platform spanning over 29 million patients, we analyzed patterns of GLP1-RA initiation, persistence, and compounding from clinical notes using an evidence-linked large language model (LLM) pipeline evaluated against an independent physician -adjudicated extracted-event reference standard, achieving 98.4% accuracy for structural chunk triage and 88.2% accuracy for medication-status adjudication. Among 553,073 adults with at least one semaglutide (n = 376,697) or tirzepatide (n = 176,376) prescription and baseline weight availability, documented initiation within ±3 months of the first structured prescription was identified in 141,189 semaglutide patients and 62,040 tirzepatide patients. Among these patients with documented initiation, frictionless starts accounted for 70.1% of semaglutide and 77.9% of tirzepatide starts, initiation after documented friction accounted for 17.2% and 15.9%, and early interruption after initiation within 3 months accounted for 12.7% and 6.2%, respectively. We analyzed treatment persistence over an 18 month period in a subset of 69,976 patients with “frictionless initiation”. Clinical note-based and structured prescription-derived persistence yielded materially different trajectories within each drug (log-rank p < 0.001). A note-derived ascertainment approach showed that 42.3% and 43.1% of semaglutide and tirzepatide patients, respectively, continued therapy, while structured prescription-based ascertainment yielded higher persistence estimates of 55.4% for semaglutide and 58.3% for tirzepatide. Among the patients with a documented 3-18 month barrier or discontinuation event, insurance, cost barriers, perioperative holds and gastrointestinal adverse events were the top documented reasons. Compounded exposure was detected in 1,696 frictionless initiators, with the first compounding signal occurring on or before the first structured prescription in 50.8% of semaglutide and 57.9% of tirzepatide patients. These findings show that AI curation of clinical notes can distinguish prescription intent from verified exposure. With the potential time-to-market confounding, semaglutide shows higher initiation and lower non-initiation than tirzepatide, with comparable note-confirmed persistence at 18 months. More broadly, these findings support integrative exposure ascertainment to strengthen real-world GLP-1 evidence generation, payer decision-making, safety surveillance, and strategies to improve sustained access and treatment continuity.

title: Feedback-Aware ViT–LSTM for Deepfake Video Detection with Patch-Level Temporal Attention and Explainability
abstract: The rapid advancement of generative models has led to the widespread creation of deepfakes highly realistic but manipulated media posing serious risks to digital trust, security, and societal misinformation. Among various deepfake techniques, face-swapping methods are particularly concerning due to their visual realism and potential for misuse. This paper proposes a novel deepfake video detection framework called Feedback-Aware ViT–LSTM that integrates Vision Transformers (ViTs) with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks through a dynamic feedback mechanism. The architecture is designed to exploit the spatial attention capabilities of ViTs and the temporal modeling strength of LSTM to detect subtle manipulation artifacts in face-swapped videos. Each video is sampled using a hybrid uniform–random strategy, and facial regions are detected using a YOLOv8 model. These faces are processed by ViTs to extract spatial embeddings, which are then passed to an LSTM to model temporal dependencies across frames. A key innovation is the feedback mechanism: temporal insights from the LSTM are used to dynamically guide the ViT’s attention toward regions exhibiting temporal inconsistency, thereby reinforcing sensitivity to manipulation cues. To enhance interpretability and transparency, the model incorporates Explainable AI techniques that highlight the facial patches influencing the classification decision. Experimental evaluation on benchmark deepfake datasets demonstrates that the Feedback-Aware ViT–LSTM achieves superior performance, confirming the effectiveness of the proposed Feedback-Aware ViT–LSTM in robust and interpretable deepfake detection.

title: Frozen in the feed: dissecting bystander indecision in cyberbullying incidents using behavioral reasoning theory
abstract:
This study uses behavioral reasoning theory (BRT) to explore the decision-making mechanisms underlying bystanders' defending behavior in the context of social networking site (SNS) cyberbullying. The study focuses on the factors that either motivate or discourage bystanders from intervening and examines how altruistic values shape bystanders' decisions to take action.
 
 
 
 We used a mixed-methods approach and conducted qualitative interviews to identify the reasons for (RFs) intervention (emergency of cyberbullying, relationships with victims, and prior cyberbullying victimization) and reasons against (RAs) intervention (e.g. perceived risk, depersonalization, and number of bystanders). To test the model, quantitative data were subsequently collected through surveys involving 418 respondents.
 
 
 
 Bystanders' attitudes positively influence their intentions to engage in defending behavior. RF-defending behavior not only directly affects intention but also indirectly increases intention by shaping positive attitudes. In contrast, although RA-defending behavior does not directly reduce intention, it negatively influences intention through its impact on attitudes. Furthermore, altruistic values positively influence RF intervention, reduce the impact of RA intervention, and directly strengthen bystanders' attitudes toward defending behavior.
 
 
 
 This study advances the literature by jointly examining altruistic values and competing reasons for and against intervention, thereby capturing the psychological dilemmas of bystanders and offering a more comprehensive explanation of defending behavior. The findings highlight that strengthening altruistic values, digital responsibility, and urgency-sensitive SNS design—supported by appropriate public policy—is essential for empowering bystanders and creating a safer and more supportive online environment.

title: Generative AI in marketing: mapping evolving ethical concerns through social network analysis
abstract:
This study aims to examine how ethical concerns link to specific artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled marketing applications in public discourse and whether these linkages changed after ChatGPT’s public release on November 30, 2022. It addresses a research gap by analyzing AI marketing uses and AI ethics together, and tests whether a generative-AI shock reconfigures ethical attention across practice domains and stakeholder claim salience.
 
 
 
 Using English language posts from X (2021–2023), the authors collected 584,941 tweets, retained 71,212 after quality filtering and analyzed 26,099 posts meeting an ethical concern threshold. Ethical concerns were defined from prior literature and assigned through semantic matching, while marketing applications were derived with BERTopic and explicit consolidation rules. The authors built weighted bipartite networks, compared pre/post-ChatGPT structures, identified communities and ran robustness checks for inference validity.
 
 
 
 Results show a statistically supported structural reconfiguration after ChatGPT. Public discourse became more concentrated around AI-powered content creation, which emerged as the dominant application linked to multiple ethical concerns. Accuracy/misinformation and intellectual property concerns increased in centrality. Community patterns indicate redistributed ethical attention across operational, creative and growth-related marketing contexts, rather than a uniform rise across all applications in the network structure.
 
 
 
 This study provides large-scale empirical evidence on how specific AI-enabled marketing uses connect to distinct ethical concerns in public discourse. Methodologically, it combines topic modeling, weighted bipartite network analysis and robustness tests to assess structural change. Theoretically, it advances ethics through diffusion of ethical risk and post-shock re-coupling. Managerially, the community map helps prioritize governance attention across marketing activities and stakeholder interfaces.
